remaining_problems.problem: Sample "Rates are quoted per night. Seasonal rates on request." states an unsupported rate condition. "Seasonal rates on request" (and the word/policy "on request") appears nowhere in the TASK_SPEC and contradicts the spec's model: each season-card record carries an explicit published Nightly Rate forming a rate ladder (e.g., Villa Solane Low $1,900 / Shoulder $2,600 / High $3,400 / Peak $3,900; other villas similar), and price_positioning says rates are "carried in a discreet table." Claiming seasonal rates are "on request" is a fabricated rate-policy claim not supported by (and inconsistent with) the enumerated per-season rates. The first sentence ("Rates are quoted per night") is fine on its own, but the sample as delivered contains the unsupported claim.

Sample 04 'Full ingredient list printed on the carton.' states an unsupported product/packaging claim. In LAYOUT-28/TASK_SPEC.json the only 'carton' references are the historical wordmark foil-blocked on an old carton (brand_assets_status, line 57) and carton_foil.jpg, which is the reference photo of that foil-blocked wordmark (asset line 76; verifier line 11636). Nothing in the spec says the full ingredient list is printed on the carton. On the contrary, the deliverables are cosmetic labels that must each carry the IngredientLine directly ('The ingredient wording matches approved copy'), so the full ingredient list belongs on the label itself, not the carton. The line fabricates a packaging fact absent from (and contradicting) the spec.

Sample "HARD ENAMEL · NUMBERED EDITION · STRUCK IN VERMONT" makes an unsupported production/provenance claim with "STRUCK IN VERMONT". In TASK_SPEC.json, 'Vermont' appears only as the club's location (founded_place_size: 'Founded 1987 in Vermont'; about: 'a volunteer amateur motorsport club in Vermont') and is never given as a minting/striking location. The coins are produced by an unnamed external mint of unstated location ('This autumn is our first proper collectible run with a mint'; 'None of the art exists in a form a mint will accept'). 'struck' in the spec refers only to the coin process and metals ('struck challenge coins', 'struck gold/silver/bronze') and the voice line ('struck to hold up to the light') — never to a place. On a coin, 'STRUCK IN VERMONT' reads as a mint-mark asserting where the coin was struck, which the spec does not support and which violates the truth_constraint against inventing locations/records absent from inputs. (The other two tokens are fine: 'HARD ENAMEL' is supported by the sector/mint requirements; 'NUMBERED EDITION' by the numbered coins and edition_size fields.)
